signal_basis.exact_text: Panel B is assigned to a comparison approval process in another unit.
In panel B, the same cases repeatedly return for documented missing fields while unrelated complete cases advance; this pattern fits case rework better than a uniform approval-stage queue.
The supplied comparisons warrant relative priorities, not exclusion of all unlisted or co-occurring causes.
